A0.declaration: Reproduction of Arnav amendment 13 through the challenger harness: B', first-FR groups, log ratio target, primary blend, v4 features, train on B' only. Must give 171.8.

d1.declaration: DEV ONLY (scored on non-P EP rows, never on B'): A0 config.

d2.declaration: DEV ONLY: d1 + train pool = all matrices' non-control rows with a same-paper control (test-fold FR identities removed).

d3.declaration: DEV ONLY: d1 + drop 100 per-name a_ columns, add P_load_wt and fr_load_wt.

d4.declaration: DEV ONLY: d3 + ECFP4 128-bit of the main SMILES-resolved FR.

d5.declaration: DEV ONLY: d1 with linear ratio target weighted by control pHRR and absolute-error HGB (loss in kW/m2).

d6.declaration: DEV ONLY: d2 (all-matrix pool) + noA + P_load/fr_load.

d7.declaration: DEV ONLY: d2 + noA + P_load + ECFP4 128.

d8.declaration: DEV ONLY: d2 with ratio_w target + hgb_l1.

d9.declaration: DEV ONLY: d2 + ECFP4 128 (keep a_ columns) + P_load.

d10.declaration: DEV ONLY: d7 + same-paper neat-control baselines (TTI, THR, avg HRR, t_pHRR, char, TSR, EHC; log1p, blank on control rows).

d11.declaration: DEV ONLY: d7 with pool = EP rows with control only (does the non-EP data help?).

d12.declaration: DEV ONLY: d10 with ExtraTrees only (gt_protocol_et).

d13.declaration: DEV ONLY: d10 with the blend's HGB member only.

d14.declaration: DEV ONLY: d10 without ECFP (noA + pload + ctrlbase).

A1.declaration: HEADLINE CANDIDATE 1. Config chosen on the dev population only (d14; B' never scored before this). Arnav's amendment-13 protocol on B' (same population, first-FR groups, seeds 0-9, 5 folds, repeat-0 group bootstrap) with: training pool = every non-control row (any matrix) with a same-paper same-flux control, minus all rows whose FR identity is in the test fold; features v4 minus the 100 per-name a_ columns, plus P_load_wt / fr_load_wt, plus same-paper neat-control TTI/THR/avgHRR/t_pHRR/char/TSR/EHC; log(pHRR/control) target; primary blend. Reported whatever the result.

A2.declaration: A1 + ECFP4 (Morgan r2, 128 bits) of the main SMILES-resolved FR (fr_smiles_extra.csv, names-only annotation), the USTC input. Not testable on dev (dev FRs mostly lack SMILES). Rule fixed now: the better of A1/A2 on B' carries forward to A3/A4; this selection is disclosed.

A3.declaration: HEADLINE CANDIDATE 2 (A2 won A1/A2 per the A2 rule). A2 with stricter FR identity groups: names-only synonym map over every first-FR key in the all-matrix pool (fr_group_alias_all.csv, built blind) + merge of identities sharing an InChIKey skeleton. Fixes the synonym leak (app vs ammonium polyphosphate, rdp variants, AlPi grades, cross-matrix synonyms). Fold map = seed-r permutation of the new group set (cannot equal Arnav's exactly). Becomes the headline if it runs, whatever the result, because it is the fairer split.

A0s.declaration: DIAGNOSTIC (coordinator request): Arnav's amendment 13 (A0) re-scored with the A3 strict groups, to measure the synonym-leak delta on his baseline.

A4.declaration: DIAGNOSTIC: A3 + also drop every row from the test fold's papers from training (FR-and-paper held out). Measures how much of A3 comes from same-paper rows / paper-identifying control features. Not the USTC protocol.

A5.declaration: ABLATION: A3 without the neat-control baseline features (ctrl TTI/THR/...), which can act as a paper fingerprint.

A6.declaration: Data Matcher population v2 (EP, bulk only, organophosphorus first FR per fr_group_alias.csv, with control) with the A3 model and groups. Closer to USTC's stated scope; reported alongside A3, not instead.

RC1.declaration: RUN CHECK (leak check, not a model change): A3 but also drop from training every row that shares ANY FR/synergist identity (norm + fr_group_alias_all + InChIKey-skeleton merge) with any row in the test fold, not only the first-FR identity (exclude_any_fr). Quantifies the non-first-component leak. Reported with A3; changes no headline.

A7.declaration: Arnav 2026-10-22, before running: A3 with ECFP4 512 bits instead of 128 (more FR structure resolution). Reported as part of a best-of-N search.

A8.declaration: Arnav 2026-10-22, before running: A3 with the Ridge member removed from the blend (HGB + ExtraTrees). Reported as part of a best-of-N search.
